==Description==
*'''D-35i''' is a ''Prime'' [[Entities|entity]]. It looks like a wide, Navy Blue smile; Of which flickers to black and back to normal at high speeds.

==Behavior==
*'''D-35i''', when it spawns, will become louder as it rushes to the main room.
*If '''D-35i''' spawned in the '''Derelict Lab''', then it will slam into the door; Otherwise, smashing it down.
*After '''D-35i''' slams/smashes the door, it will form a portal beneath itself, swiftly escaping. There's a low chance it can spawn another '''D-35i''' (High chance in [[Red Rooms]])
**This process can repeat itself unitil four '''D-35i''' have spawned, tho its not very common to get 4 at once, usually spawning one or two '''D-35i'''

==Strategy & Tips ==
*Stay near a locker when [[D-35]] despawns, and after approximately 0-5 seconds, ''D-35i'' will spawn with a little chance, and you will start to hear it.

==Trivia==
*'''D-35i''' cannot '''Locker Snipe''' in the [[Red Rooms]].
*'''D-35i''' (and [[D-35|It's normal counterpart]]) can be dodge-rolled through to survive.
